current_source_defenses.observed_guard: reject existing-file rewrite below 0.5 of previous character length for sufficiently large files

hypothesis.claim: For narrow modifications to tracked existing text files, bounded patch/diff editing against exact preimage identity reduces accidental unrelated deletion versus unconstrained whole-file regeneration.

counterhypotheses.claim: Patch syntax alone does not prevent broad deletion; a narrow acceptance test can still pass.
A 50 percent shrink threshold can miss harmful smaller deletions and can reject legitimate explicit refactors.

proposed_edit_contract: resolve exact repository root and path
default to bounded unified diff for existing tracked text files
inspect resulting diff and changed path set
commit only after all gates pass
restore exact preimage on any failure

adversarial_discriminator.fixture: large file with unrelated functions A/B/C; request only D; target acceptance checks only D
candidates: patch deleting B/C while adding D
whole-file replacement retaining more than 50 percent length but deleting one critical unrelated function

external_primary.relevance: git apply --check and context-sensitive atomic patch application behavior
diff inspection, --check, full-index object identity surface
